notes: New: major software updates. When a new version of the app itself is out, a "Major software update" pop-up appears when the app starts (and the Software update button turns green).
Tap "Install now": Android downloads the new app and asks "Do you want to update this app?" (tap Update, then Open). Mac and Windows download, install and restart by themselves.
Normal updates (screens and reports) now also show what's new in a pop-up before you install them.
Settings shows both versions: the POS date and the app number (for example "app 1.5.0").
